title: Best Crowdfunding Video Makers (2026): Campaign Videos
description: How to hire a crowdfunding video maker for Kickstarter or Indiegogo campaigns: script, footage, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Crowdfunding video makers create the short video at the top of a Kickstarter or Indiegogo page. The video introduces you, shows the product and explains why people should back it now. A good video builds trust in a few minutes. Campaigns suffer when the video is too long, does not show a real prototype, or promises more than the team can deliver. This guide helps you get a campaign video that is honest and convincing.

faq.q: How long should a crowdfunding video be?
faq.a: Short enough to hold attention. Many successful videos keep the key message in the first seconds and stay brief overall. Platform guides offer advice.

faq.q: Do I need to appear on camera?
faq.a: Usually it helps. Backers want to see the people behind the project. Even a short honest introduction builds trust.
Yes. Animation explains how things work. Combine it with real footage of a prototype where possible.
The prototype in use, the team, the workshop or studio, and short clips of real people using the product.

faq.q: Can I show features that are not finished?
faq.a: Be honest. Platforms have rules about showing renders as real products. Label concepts clearly.
